items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: So, I got a chance to really hear Bessie in this theater a couple of times.

ctx.x: So, I'd sit in with them several times. I didn't know too much about what I was doing but I had a lot of fun playing with them, you know, and I learned a lot, you know, around guys like this.

And at that time there was a theater in Richmond in the colored section right around Second and Lee, and this was '26 to '29 around at that time -- called the Hippodrome Theater. And Bessie Smith used to come there a lot. So, I got a chance to really hear Bessie in this theater a couple of times. And I'd go back to school, you know, in September.

I'd work little odd jobs not actually playing music. But in school I took up bricklaying. And so, a guy -- my instructor was from Richmond, Pappa Joe. I don't remember his last name, but anyway, he'd get little jobs for some of us around Richmond. And this was how we picked up a few dollars.
